mcps.name: blender
mcps.desc: Blender 3D modeling MCP that lets any LLM drive Blender via natural language for modeling, scene creation, and manipulation. After installation you must also enable the Blender add-on: run 'uvx blender-mcp install-addon', check "Interface: Blender MCP" under Edit → Preferences → Add-ons, then press N in the 3D viewport to open the sidebar and click "Start MCP Server" in the BlenderMCP tab (defaults to localhost:9876).
mcps.desc-zh: Blender 3D 建模 MCP，让任意 LLM 通过自然语言驱动 Blender 完成建模、场景创建与操控。安装后还需启用 Blender 插件：uvx blender-mcp install-addon，在 Edit → Preferences → Add-ons 勾选 Interface: Blender MCP，再到 3D 视口按 N 打开侧栏，BlenderMCP 标签页点击 Start MCP Server（默认 localhost:9876）。

mcps.name: chrome-devtools
mcps.desc: Chrome DevTools MCP that provides web performance analysis, debugging, and automated diagnostics capabilities.
mcps.desc-zh: Chrome DevTools MCP，提供网页性能分析、调试与自动化诊断能力。

mcps.name: markitdown
mcps.desc: MarkItDown MCP that converts various file formats such as Office/PDF/HTML into Markdown text.
mcps.desc-zh: MarkItDown MCP，将 Office/PDF/HTML 等多种文件转换为 Markdown 文本。

mcps.name: playwright
mcps.desc: Browser automation MCP that provides web page screenshot, interaction, and testing capabilities.
mcps.desc-zh: 浏览器自动化 MCP，提供网页截图、交互与测试能力。

mcps.name: tavily-remote-mcp
mcps.desc: Tavily Search MCP (remote edition) that provides web search and deep-research API capabilities for AI. After installation, replace <your-api-key> with your own Tavily API key.
mcps.desc-zh: Tavily 搜索 MCP（远程版），为 AI 提供联网搜索与深度研究 API 能力。安装后需将 <your-api-key> 替换为你的 Tavily API Key。

mcps.name: tdx
mcps.desc: TDX (Tongdaxin) market data MCP that connects directly to TDX quote servers, offering A-share real-time quotes, K-line, intraday, rankings, F10, technical indicators, and more.
mcps.desc-zh: 通达信（TDX）行情数据 MCP，直连通达信行情服务器，提供 A 股实时行情、K 线、分时、排行榜、F10 与技术指标等工具。
